backend/main.mo: Motoko actor implementing an e-commerce backend with product management (CRUD operations), shopping cart functionality per user principal, order placement with customer details, and admin authentication via password verification.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two completed features related to debugging and verifying the Admin navigation link visibility and routing in the Header component.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend source files including components, pages, hooks, and utilities for the Swapan Store e-commerce application with Indian grocery store theming.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining OKLCH color system for light and dark modes, including sidebar, chart, and UI component color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Swapan Store application with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: TanStack Router configuration defining application routes (products, cart, checkout, admin dashboard, admin login) with ErrorBoundary wrappers and layout components including Header and Footer.
Dialog modal component with form inputs for creating new products including name, description, price, category dropdown, and image URL with validation and loading states.
frontend/src/components/EditProductModal: Dialog modal component for editing existing products with pre-populated form fields, validation, and update functionality using the useUpdateProduct hook.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: React error boundary component that catches and displays errors with a fallback UI, showing error details in a collapsible section and providing a reload button.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying copyright information and a "Built with caffeine.ai" attribution link with a heart icon.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header component with logo, search bar, navigation links (Products/Admin), and a cart button with item count badge.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Product card component displaying product image, name, description, price, and quantity controls with an "Add to Cart" button. Includes error handling for missing product data and image loading failures.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, creating authenticated or anonymous actors and invalidating dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminAuth.ts: Custom hook managing admin authentication state using sessionStorage, providing login/logout functions and authentication status.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing AuthClient creation, login flow, identity state, and delegation validation with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for backend operations including fetching products, managing cart contents (get/add/remove), updating product prices, placing orders, and fetching orders with admin authentication checks.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm, earthy Indian spice market color palette for both light and dark modes, including primary (turmeric golden), destructive (chili red), and various accent colors.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClientProvider for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, then renders the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page for managing products and viewing orders, featuring product price editing, add/edit product modals, product-to-local-image mapping, and authentication checks with logout functionality.
frontend/src/pages/AdminLoginPage.tsx: Admin login page with password verification form that uses useVerifyAdminPassword hook to authenticate and redirects to admin dashboard on success.
frontend/src/pages/CartPage.tsx: Shopping cart page displaying cart items with local image mapping, quantity display, remove functionality, total price calculation, and checkout navigation with empty cart state handling.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Checkout page with order summary, phone number and address input forms, validation logic, and order placement functionality that redirects to products page on success.
frontend/src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx: Main products listing page with category filtering, search functionality, local image mapping for products, and extensive debug logging for troubleshooting product data flow.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrice.ts: Utility function that formats numeric price values to Indian Rupee format with ₹ symbol prefix and two decimal places.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file defining custom theme extensions including color schemes using OKLCH format, font families (Inter, Poppins), container settings, border radius variables, custom shadows, and accordion animations. Includes typography, container queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file for Swapan Store e-commerce app (version 29) documenting existing features like product listings, shopping cart, admin dashboard, and known issues including products not displaying on deployed pages and missing admin navigation link.
